verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs state that when self-hosted, 'nothing is sent to Arize and can be fully air-gapped,' implying no forced telemetry to the vendor, which directly supports a privacy-conscious opt-out posture. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated telemetry/usage-tracking toggle (e.g., an env var or CLI flag to disable analytics) for the hosted or default install path. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out mechanism/config flag for anonymous usage analytics, confirmation of what telemetry (if any) is collected by default in non-air-gapped mode.
